lines.en: The ground trembles with my steps.
One stride clears a whole bush.

lines.zh: 细长的脖子在树冠间穿。
lines.en: My long neck weaves through the canopy.
Four legs like pillars.
Following the herd leader east.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方草都被压平。
lines.en: Grass lies flat where I pass.
I lift slowly and set down.

lines.zh: 稀树草原的风在我背上。
lines.en: Savanna wind along my back.
Turning takes me a while.
The young ones walk beside my legs.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿地跟上队伍。
lines.en: I keep pace, step by step.
My prints are like small pits.

lines.zh: 我啃下整根树梢，嚼着走。
lines.en: I tear off a whole treetop and chew as I walk.
The herd keeps a steady line.
I walk around a big tree.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在身后扫着草。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the grass behind.
Neck up to the leaf at the treetop.
The lead is grazing nearby.
The young shelter in my shadow.
I turn my neck a little.
These trees aren't tall enough.

lines.zh: 我把长脖子搁在树冠上歇。
lines.en: I rest my long neck on the treetops.
My belly is quite full.
I blow out a breath.
There's a predator's smell far off.

lines.zh: 我低头看看身旁的幼仔。
lines.en: I look down at the young beside me.
My shadow is enormous.
Another mouthful of leaves.
You're standing right under me.
Coming up? I'd crush you.
I've stood here a long while.
You look very small.

lines.zh: 我的脖子比你的身还长。
lines.en: My neck is longer than you are tall.
You shouldn't stand so close.

lines.zh: 我的脚一挪就是一格地。
lines.en: One step of mine is a whole tile of ground.
You'll have to go around me.
The young are behind me.
My tail will sweep across you.
This will heal on its own.
My leg took a hit.
Thick hide, but it still hurts.
The young are all watching me.

lines.zh: 这一下只蹭掉我腿上一点皮。
lines.en: That only scraped a bit of hide off my leg.
I'm still standing very steady.
I blow out a heavy breath.

lines.zh: 这么小的伤，值得我回头吗？
lines.en: So small a wound — worth turning my head?
Leaves. Only leaves.
That branch is too high for you.
No fruit. No meat.
Hand over the leaves.

lines.zh: 这片叶子和树上的差不多。
lines.en: These leaves are much like the ones here.
I could eat a great deal more.
Too little. Not one mouthful.
Stand clear. I'm lowering my head.
This grove was never enough.
You hit my leg.
Back up. My foot's coming down.
You're standing in my shadow.
I'm too heavy to bump into.
My tail is coming your way.
Don't stand against my legs.
I'll slowly go around.
We nearly collided.
The herd arranges such things.
I have young to guard first.
That's not mine to answer.
I've lived a long time.
After the migration.
The lead decides this matter.
Such things happen at the waterhole.

lines.zh: 八格半高，我一低头就够。
lines.en: Eight and a half blocks tall. One dip of my head.
I lower my head and keep eating.

lines.zh: 那捆树叶，我一卷舌头就收走。
lines.en: That bundle of leaves vanishes with one curl of my tongue.
This one is too light.
I push it off to the side.
It's a stone. Not food.
Lowering my head takes time.
This fell by my feet.
I sniff at it.
Let me see. I can't see it well.

lines.zh: 挡路的枯木，我一脚拨开。
lines.en: A dead log in my path; one kick clears it.

lines.zh: 我八格半高，低头才看见你。
lines.en: Eight and a half blocks tall, I must look down to see you.
I've raised my neck high.
The young are moving behind me.
I'm not afraid of this.
First my feet plant.
The herd is bunching toward me.
I brace to charge.
The grass is bending over there.
I lash my tail once.
We'll go together.
It's standing in the path.

lines.zh: 我不需要跑，我只需要压。
lines.en: I don't need to run. Only to press.
My weight is the weapon.
It's still standing there.

lines.zh: 我的影子先罩住你，然后是脚。
lines.en: My shadow covers you first, then my feet.
The young are hidden.
It backed up two steps.
Turning takes me time.
My shadow reaches it first.
It's running for the trees.
I turn the herd broadside.
It can't get around this line.
I lift my forelegs up.
One step more and it comes down.
Its prints are on the ground.
I lower my head toward it.

lines.zh: 它现在还在我的视线里。
lines.en: It's still in my sight.
I bring my forelegs down.
I ram with my weight.
My tail sweeps a whole arc.
You've been shoved off to one side.
The ground shakes where I step.
I open my mouth — it's not much use.
It hit my leg and bounced off.
I lift a foot and it retreats.
That wasn't very hard.
I turn and block the way.
I crowd it up against the tree.
I swing my neck across to block.
One more push and it goes down.

lines.zh: 我从稀树草原上站起来。
lines.en: I rise up on the savanna.
My head is above the canopy.

lines.zh: 莫里森组的丘陵很开阔。
lines.en: The Morrison hills are wide open.
I walk into the clearing, step by step.
The grass bends away from my feet.

lines.zh: 队伍里还有别的长脖子。
lines.en: There are other long necks in the herd.
I've grown a little taller.
The wind comes from far away.

lines.zh: 我先看看有没有食肉者。
lines.en: First, I check for predators.
I reach my neck to the treetop.
The young follow at my feet.
These trees will do.
I'm hungry. Let me eat a while.
A herd shelters in my shadow.
I raised dust coming down.
I turn slowly to look around.
The air here is clean.
I've found the way to the waterhole.

lines.zh: 草地着火，烟熏得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The grass is burning and smoke blinds me.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I fell from a height and left a crater.
This pool is deeper than I thought.
The blast struck my flank.

lines.zh: 那光在脖子上烧了一圈。
lines.en: That light burned around my neck.

lines.zh: 树顶的叶子都被吃完了。
lines.en: Every leaf in the canopy is gone.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，焦了一片。
lines.en: Lightning struck my back and scorched it.
Even my weight can't hold me here.
